title: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
author: Raze
summary: Customizable full-map and minimap markers for Seeker's Tokens, Golden Trove Beetles, and chests. Includes upright minimap icons, shared category controls, and expanded icon limits.

required_mods.name: REFramework
required_mods.notes: Required. Install REFramework for Dragon's Dogma 2 before this mod.

main_file.name: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
main_file.description: Version 1.0. Full-map and minimap collectible markers with expanded icon capacity. Requires REFramework. Supports manual installation or Fluffy Mod Manager. Disable Arisen's Almanac before installing.
